reviewer_role: Content-owner source/question verification; not independent approval
review_method: All153 Navigator and CAS normative paragraphs and all current substantive questions were read control by control. Authored safeguard-specific observations were written before compiling this matrix; automated checks establish mapping/integrity, not semantic correctness.

decision_contract.basis: Application reported-implementation status policy; not CIS-issued certification. Source questions are evaluated as substantive facts, not percentage completion.
decision_contract.no_meaningful_facts: Not Assessed; unknown is not an affirmative deficiency.
decision_contract.confirmed_total_absence: Not Implemented when every applicable substantive fact is absent or the established supported root-absence branch applies.
decision_contract.known_partial_implementation: Partially Implemented when meaningful implementation exists but material applicable facts are missing/unresolved.
decision_contract.complete: Implemented when all applicable substantive requirements are accepted and no factual contradiction remains; evidence verification is separate.
decision_contract.aggregate_uncertainty: For generic matrices, Not sure aggregate does not add a source obligation when all atomic facts are supported. Affirmative No/Partially contradicting supported facts requires confirmation.
decision_contract.conditional_exclusion: Only the actual source condition plus rationale permits row-level exclusion. All-excluded results remain Not Assessed pending native whole-record applicability approval.
decision_contract.optional_context: Absent optional tools/owner/narrative/evidence context cannot lower status. Only uncertainty about substantive source requirements may prevent an implementation conclusion.

not_executed: No hosted authentication, save/reload or client-data writes.
No independent approval of earlier IG1 content.
